reason: Lint: TimelineChart's least-height measurement (the react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning at TimelineChart:162) no longer runs after every render with no dependency list. It runs when the view's layout switches (fold, phone, Distribution view, tabs), and from a ResizeObserver on the measured parts and a MutationObserver on the analysis area, applied with flushSync. A new timeline-height test pins a case the old code missed: a run guide line the run row (PlayBar) renders on its own, with run notices on screen, now raises the floor by its height. No path in the app was found that changes the run row alone like this. Measured: no measurement and no mutation callback while idle; no floor observers left when folded or at the phone width. npm run lint fails above 68 warnings (was 69); no exhaustive-deps warning is left in view, and the rule stays a warning while the ones under suppression comments remain. #625 item 5.
